stories.title: Telegram Warns iPhone Users Are Being Hacked on a Massive Scale; Just Visiting a Website Could Be Enough
stories.description: Telegram is sending security alerts to iPhone users running older versions of iOS, CEO Pavel Durov said on November 27.

stories.title: Suspected Vietnam-Linked Hackers Target Southeast Asia in South China Sea Espionage Campaign
stories.description: Suspected Vietnam-linked WeaveLotus hackers compromised five Thai and Philippine targets and conducted reconnaissance against Indonesian agencies.

stories.title: Hackers Set Freezer Controls to 100°C, Then Lock Technicians Out of the System
stories.description: Hackers changed a freezer chamber’s temperature setting to 100°C at Salamerija Alpija, a meat processing plant in Tolmin, Slovenia.

stories.title: 12-Year-Old NFS2ROOT Linux Flaw Let Hackers Take Full Control of Servers Without a Password
stories.description: A critical Linux kernel flaw called NFS2ROOT could let an attacker take full control of an unpatched Network File System (NFS) server without logging in.

stories.title: Hackers Break Into U.S. Air Force Cloud Platform Used to Manage Military Operations and Data
stories.description: Hackers broke into Cloud One, the U.S. Air Force’s main cloud computing platform, putting sensitive military, personnel, and logistics data at risk.

stories.title: Microsoft Store App Found Delivering Vinci RAT Capable of Remote System Control
stories.description: Attackers abused a Microsoft Store app called Setup Assistant to deploy Vinci RAT, a previously undocumented PowerShell-based remote access trojan.

stories.title: In Other News: Tanker Cyberattacks, EU Quantum Act, New VirusTotal Capabilities
stories.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: RansomwareHelp accused of profiting from ransom payments, USDA payment systems breach, cybersecurity firm Radware hacked.

stories.title: How to Keep Your Security Picture Current When Attackers Move at AI Speed
stories.description: Continuous security posture visibility helps teams address outdated metrics, fragmented data, and the growing pace of AI-accelerated threats.

stories.title: 100,000 Potentially Impacted by Colorado Data Breach
stories.description: Hackers breached the digital identification and document storage application myColorado and accessed user-uploaded data.

stories.title: Hackers Trojanize Official Q-Dir and DesktopOK Downloads to Deliver Remote Access Malware
stories.description: Trojanized Q-Dir and DesktopOK installers from SoftwareOK's official website deploy a Python RAT capable of remote command execution.

stories.title: Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach
stories.description: A vulnerability in hex.pm allowed hackers to run commands on web servers. No evidence of data modification was found, but database reads are not logged.

stories.title: SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised
stories.description: SAP has detected suspicious activity on GitHub, where hackers reportedly used stolen employee tokens to copy and alter source code.
